Non-Regulated Activities

Complete reference guide for business licensing codes, activity descriptions, and regulatory conditions in the Qatar Financial Centre

Shipping & Maritime Services

Vessel agency, ship broking, classification services, and credit rating for maritime activities.

Click here to view the full Non-Regulated Activities 

C1

Shipping Agents

Activities related to the management, agency, and operational support of vessels and maritime transport.

5230-001

Arranging and negotiating the buying and selling of ships for unaffiliated Persons

5230-002

Handling paperwork and customs (and other requirements relating to shipping)

5230-003

Organising storage, fuel and maintenance of vessels

5230-004

Other ancillary services relating to shipping agencies

Shipping Agents

Custom Clearance:

Unless otherwise permitted by the QFCA, may not provide custom clearance services to any Person.

Port Authority:

All activities subject to compliance with Qatar Ports Management Authority regulations.

C2

Ship Broking

Chartering, sale and purchase broking, and maritime commercial negotiation services.

5231-001

Arranging or negotiating the employment of a vessel

5231-002

Arranging the transportation of goods and commodities

5231-003

Brokerage for time and bareboat charter

5231-004

Other ancillary services relating to ship broking

5231-005

Initiating and originating deals for the sale of ships

5231-006

Assisting in negotiations for the sale of ships

5231-007

Assisting in drawing up a contract for sale of ships

Shipping Agents

Custom Clearance:

Unless otherwise permitted by the QFCA, may not provide custom clearance services to any Person.

Qualified Brokers:

Personnel must hold recognized maritime brokerage qualifications or equivalent experience.

Professional Services

Advisory, consultancy, IT, legal, accounting, architectural, and administrative professional services.

C10

Advisory and Consultancy

Management consulting, tax, HR, immigration, and specialized industry advisory services.

C10.1

Management and Business Consulting

7020-001

Strategic, operating model and organisational planning

7020-002

Financial planning and budgeting

7020-003

Providing advice on the feasibility of entering new businesses or markets

7020-004

Reviewing data and assisting in the preparation of initial public offering documents and private placement documents

7020-005

Advising clients on how to fund their business

7020-006

Business and investment valuations and other financial modelling

7020-018

Advising on mergers, joint ventures and acquisitions

7020-007

Human resources strategy and talent management advisory

7020-008

Immigration and workforce mobility consulting

C10.2

Tax Consultancy

6920-001

Advising on tax issues

6920-002

Tax compliance services

6920-004

Preparation of tax returns

6920-006

Transfer pricing advisory and documentation

6920-007

Tax dispute resolution and representation services

General Conditions

Professional Competence:

Must possess required knowledge and skill for carrying on all activities set out in its licence (Rule 3.7).

No Regulated Activities:

May not carry on any Regulated Activity unless holding appropriate approval from the QFCRA.

Indemnity Insurance:

Professional indemnity insurance required for all advisory activities (minimum QAR 2,000,000).
